# `aitbc ai accept`

Accept a completed AI job and release the escrowed payment.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc ai accept [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--job-id` | text | — | yes | Job ID to accept |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc ai accept --job-id <job_id>
```
